Natural Specimens
Polished Fluorite Heart and Raw Stone Collection
Mineral, Stone, and Seashell Set
Approx. 1" to 1.75" Dimensions
Unsigned
This eclectic collection features four distinct natural elements, headlined by a hand-polished green and blue fluorite heart. The fluorite exhibits characteristic translucency and internal crystalline structures typical of the mineral. Accompanying the heart is a weathered river stone with a smooth, water-worn texture, a raw mineral specimen with granular surface detail, and a naturally aged bivalve seashell with distinct ribbing and radial symmetry.
Polished fluorite heart displays vibrant shades of teal and forest green
Rough mineral specimen features crystalline inclusions and earthy tones
Natural bivalve seashell shows classic radial symmetry and weathered white finish
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. The fluorite heart is polished to a high gloss with minor internal fissures typical of the mineral. The raw stones and shell show natural textures, weathering, and geological characteristics consistent with their natural and geological origins.

281856047.description:
Shark Tooth Fossil Lot - 3 Pieces
What A Earth, Natural History & Paleontology Specimens
Fossilized Shark Teeth, Eocene to Cretaceous Era
This collection features three authentic fossilized shark tooth specimens, individually mounted in clear hinged display cases over blue foam inserts. Each specimen exhibits distinct anatomical features including intact roots, cusps, and enamel characteristic of prehistoric lamniform shark species. Packaged by What A Earth with educational background information on the reverse, these specimens offer great appeal for fossil enthusiasts, geology classrooms, and specimen collectors.
Items Included:
Fossil Shark Tooth 1 - Central triangular tooth with wide root and defined enamel crown, housed in clear plastic case
Fossil Shark Tooth 2 - Symmetrical crown with intact root lobes and light brown mineralization, housed in clear plastic case
Fossil Shark Tooth 3 - Pointed crown with lateral cusplets and root structure, housed in clear plastic case
Condition:
Teeth are in good fossilized condition with natural mineral preservation, sharp tip edges, and stable root matrix. Clear plastic display cases show light surface scuffs from handling and retail price stickers on the back cards with no cracks to the acrylic housings.

Natural Geode Specimens
Set of Two Quartz Crystal Formations
Natural Mineral Specimen
Total Weight: 5.14 lbs

This pair of natural geode specimens features prominent internal crystalline structures characteristic of quartz formations. The larger, more rounded piece showcases a deep cavity lined with translucent to opaque white crystals, while the second piece displays a more open, heart-shaped configuration. Both specimens retain their natural, rough exterior matrix, providing a striking contrast between the rugged outer shell and the delicate crystalline interior.
Rounder geode measures approximately 6.25" x 4.25" x 4"
Authentic mineral specimens with natural crystalline sparkle and textural variety
Ideal for geological study, home decor display, or as a natural history collectible
Total combined weight of 5.14 lbs as measured on a digital scale
